tagline.en_US: Start Loki in its built-in single-binary configuration with local filesystem storage.

description.en_US: Grafana Loki is a multi-tenant log aggregation system inspired by Prometheus. Instead of indexing the full text of logs, it indexes metadata labels and stores compressed, unstructured log data. It operates as a backend service responsible for storing logs and processing queries, typically queried and displayed through Grafana or command-line tools.
